rationale: A web ACL holding no rule inspects nothing: every request reaches the protected resource under the default action, exactly as if no WAF were in front of it. Such an ACL is usually one that was created to satisfy a requirement and never completed, and it is worse than no ACL at all because the association makes the resource look protected in every inventory and in the console.
remediation: Add rules to the web ACL, starting with the AWS managed baseline rule groups, or delete it and stop presenting the resource as protected
